reviews.text: They really care about animals, they treat your pet as if it were their own

I had a great experience bringing Peanut to Dr. Gambino for her checkup and vaccines. Dr. Gambino was very kind and caring with Peanut, and everything was explained clearly. Peanut was well taken care of, and I’m very happy with the visit. Thank you, Dr. Gambino!
Very unwelcoming experience. The receptionist was extremely unwelcoming from the moment I arrived. I did not feel comfortable or treated with basic courtesy.

I wanted to express my sincere gratitude to the entire team at the Brooklyn veterinary group. They were incredibly professional and kind, and their patient care truly surprised me. My aggressive, terrible cat was finally able to undergo an X-ray! I can’t believe someone else could comfort him to the place/ room where he’s never been, and yes, his poor poopy finally turned healthy.
Dr. Gambino is incredible. She's so knowledgeable, caring, and personable. Highly recommend!

Dr. Dodd is absolutely amazing and the staff is wonderful. Extremely caring and meticulous vet office. Dr. Dodd is comforting and also honest, and has given me hope and solace for my senior kitties care and liver problems. The front staff is great, they're caring and awnser my questions promptly and have made last minute appointments for my cat with no issue. I'm so glad I found this vet office and I would highly recommend it to anyone and everyone who has a pet. In my opinion, especially for Brooklyn, they are very fairly priced.

To say that our experience today as first-time clients at Brooklyn Veterinary Group was beyond reproach would be an understatement. It was absolutely stellar from beginning to end.

From the moment we first called to make the appointment, to being seen at our precise appointment time, we were genuinely impressed by the professionalism, warmth, and kindness of everyone we encountered.

Stephen, who (I believe) is the head veterinary technician, was simply extraordinary.
What an asset he is to that practice !!! He made us feel so instantly comfortable - he even sang lamb chop the theme song to the Sherry Lewis show ! Lol
He's a veritable wealth important information, not only personable but wildly knowledgeable about animal behavior/care/science.
We were earnestly stunned by how much he taught us in such a short amount of time.
Not for one moment did we feel rushed, nor did we ever feel pressured to purchase or do anything beyond what we had specifically come in for.
In fact, we asked plenty of unrelated questions about our dog’s diet, vaccines, medications, flea and tick control, and general care, and every question was answered thoroughly and enthusiastically.
You can immediately tell when people truly have a passion for what they do, and that passion is wildly evident in Steven &  throughout this entire practice.

Rosa and Brianna (who also does their social media) at the front desk were phenomenal—welcoming, accommodating, courteous, and incredibly helpful.
Steph, the more junior vet tech, was so sweet &  affectionate with our dog, Lamb Chop, that you would have thought they knew each other for years!!! That kind of genuine love for animals simply cannot be taught.

And finally, we met Dr. Pernice. He gave Lamb Chop an amazingly thorough examination and took so much time explaining every detail of what he believed was going on. He was knowledgeable, patient, kind, and an absolute gentleman.
We had heard wonderful things about him before our visit, and it quickly became apparent that his great reputation precedes him with very good reason.

I have had pets—both dogs and cats—my entire life, and I can sincerely say that I have never had such a superior experience at a veterinary office.

I cannot imagine any situation in the future that I would not EXCLUSIVELY use Brooklyn Veterinary Group.
It took only one visit for us to understand why they are truly a cut above the rest.

Thank you, Dr. Pernice, Stephen, Steph, Rosa, Brianna, and the entire team for taking such wonderful care of Lamb Chop and for making our first visit such an exceptional experience. You have absolutely earned our trust and our highest recommendation.

I’ve been bringing my dog here since November after her groomer recommended this clinic, and I couldn’t be happier. My dog is 14 years old and had been going to the Humane Society of New York since she was a puppy, but after bringing her here for a dental cleaning, I just kept coming back.

The location is super convenient for me, the prices are very reasonable, and most importantly, the care is outstanding. Dr. Dodd is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING. He’s incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and patient. I’m definitely one of those pet moms who worries about everything, and I’ve emailed him more times than I can count. He always takes the time to respond, answer my questions, and put my mind at ease. That means so much to me.

Everyone at the clinic has been wonderful—from the front desk staff to the technicians. Robert deserves a special thank you for always being so caring and helpful. I truly feel like everyone here goes above and beyond for both me and my dog.

Now that my girl is a senior, she needs a little extra love and attention, and I genuinely feel like she’s getting the best care here. I’m so grateful for everything you’ve done for us, and I think this is where we’ll be staying from now on.

Thank you all so much for taking such wonderful care of my best friend♥️
